agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state and claims no C PASS.
v2 now strict-validates inherited routing booleans before v1 routing, and v2.1 strict-validates secretary_signal_fresh, authority_conflict and direct verification booleans.
v2 real_experience_claim_allowed requires both verified-kind credit and C_VERIFIED stage; this is useful fail-closed stage hardening but still is not trusted verifier provenance.
v2.1 keeps DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND operational-only, while HEARTBEAT/POLL/RETRY/WAIT/SCHEDULER_WAKE remain zero Experience.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in current bytes and cannot itself raise gear or create Experience; keep it observational.
N/R terminal states bypass anti-thrash numeric gear parsing and malformed non-Mapping ledger elements are bounded ignores.
The v2.1 contract correctly marks speedup NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.

disagreements.finding: New current-byte material gap: EventKind canonicalization is internally inconsistent even for string inputs. experience_candidate_delta() uses str(...).strip().upper(), but select_gear_v2 later evaluates verified_event using event_kind.upper() on the original unstripped value, while select_gear_v2_1 classifies kind with str(...).upper() without strip. Therefore ' VERIFIED_RECOVERY ' can receive positive verified credit from experience_candidate_delta yet fail verified_event classification, and ' DURABLE_PROGRESS ' can receive positive delta yet fail the v2.1 operational_kinds membership test. The same logical event can therefore produce contradictory credit/classification depending on code path.
disagreements.required_change: Introduce one canonical typed EventKind parser returning a normalized enum/string exactly once and use only that canonical value in experience_candidate_delta, v2 verified_event logic, v2.1 ledger classification and v2.1 direct decision projection. Reject unsupported types fail-closed; trim/case normalization semantics must be versioned and tested.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events canonicalizes event_id with str(...).strip(), so arbitrary caller types are accepted as identity; numeric 1 and string '1' silently alias while mappings/lists/objects can acquire unstable string identities.
disagreements.required_change: Define a versioned strict EventIdentity boundary and bind accepted identity to canonical event hash, evidence hash, verifier receipt and durable acceptance record.

disagreements.finding: v2 rounds pressure to four decimals before comparing against 0.45/0.70 routing thresholds, allowing presentation quantization to alter control classification near the gate.
disagreements.required_change: Route on unrounded canonical pressure; round only presentation telemetry. Numeric thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events inserts event_id into transient seen before proving accepted verified/operational credit; irrelevant or zero-credit first claims can suppress later corrected bindings in the same batch.
disagreements.required_change: Reserve identity only after canonical acceptance; exact replay=NO_OP and same ID/different binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: Verifier parsing occurs before duplicate handling, so malformed replay of an already-seen ID can abort the batch instead of becoming bounded replay handling.
disagreements.required_change: Recognize immutable accepted identity/receipt before mutable-field parsing; exact replay must be NO_OP and malformed rebinding must not censor later evidence.

disagreements.finding: independently_verified is parsed for every valid-ID mapping before event class is known; WAIT/HEARTBEAT/DURABLE_PROGRESS with malformed verifier metadata can abort later valid evidence although verifier metadata is irrelevant to those classes.
disagreements.required_change: Canonicalize/classify EventKind first; parse verifier evidence only for verified kinds and isolate malformed non-atomic records.

disagreements.finding: v2 normalizes current_gear with strip().upper(), while v2.1 rereads raw current_gear with upper() only before integer parsing; an input accepted by inherited v2 can fail in the overlay.
disagreements.required_change: Normalize once or derive current_gear from canonical runtime state; never reparse raw caller bytes.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller declarations. Strict bool proves type only, not source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy or runtime/installation binding.
disagreements.required_change: Require trusted SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope with replay-resistant provenance/freshness binding.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load or enforce the exact fresh authority decision, so permissive fallback kwargs still control routing.
disagreements.required_change: Project the exact trusted fresh authority snapshot or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: Secretary freshness protects secretary_level only; numeric pressure fields have no per-field provenance/freshness and can carry stale secretary-derived telemetry into routing.
disagreements.required_change: Bind provenance/freshness per pressure component; stale secretary-derived components contribute zero while independently trusted telemetry may contribute.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still depends on event kind, booleans and stage labels; exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt are not mandatory.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity and trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate call. Same evidence under new IDs, cross-run/restart/rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can still be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Every nonzero credit must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Public v2 still exposes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND through experience_candidate_delta although v2.1 classifies them operational-only.
disagreements.required_change: Unify authoritative classification across v2/v2.1; operational progress must never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never use aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup; commit count, wake count and awake time are invalid proxies.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance, exposure/censoring/order, complete assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Inconsistent EventKind normalization can make the same logical event receive positive credit in one path but fail verified/operational classification in another, corrupting longitudinal totals and paired comparisons.
Non-canonical event_id coercion can create silent identity collisions or unstable structured identities, invalidating duplicate/replay rates and longitudinal credit estimates.
Pressure rounding before control thresholds can create artificial discontinuities around 0.45/0.70.
Caller-declared freshness/authority and unbound pressure provenance invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle/closure/recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later connected to routing authority; it must remain observational until independently derived and tested.
Transient event IDs, same-evidence/new-ID replay, identity poisoning and direct credit bypass can inflate or censor longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Operational-vs-Experience semantics differ between v2 and v2.1, making mixed-consumer metrics incomparable.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-EVENT-KIND-WHITESPACE-101: ' VERIFIED_RECOVERY ' and canonical VERIFIED_RECOVERY must normalize to one canonical EventKind and produce identical verified classification/credit; same for DURABLE_PROGRESS operational classification.

GB21-EVENT-KIND-CROSSPATH-102: experience_candidate_delta, select_gear_v2, aggregate_experience_events and select_gear_v2_1 must consume the same canonical EventKind value; no path may reparse original caller bytes.
GB21-EVENT-ID-TYPE-098 + EVENT-ID-ALIAS-099 + EVENT-ID-STRUCTURAL-100: adoptable event identity rejects arbitrary types and uses deterministic canonical identity semantics.
GB21-PRESSURE-ROUNDING-096 + PRESSURE-MONOTONIC-097: routing follows unrounded canonical pressure around 0.45/0.70.
GB21-EVENT-ID-POISON-094 + DUPLICATE-PARSE-DOS-095: invalid/zero-credit claims cannot consume identity; exact replay is NO_OP and malformed rebinding cannot censor later evidence.
GB21-IRRELEVANT-VERIFIER-BATCH-091 + OPERATIONAL-VERIFIER-BATCH-092: malformed verifier metadata on zero/operational kinds cannot abort later valid evidence.
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-NORMALIZATION-093: current_gear canonicalizes once and overlay behavior matches inherited v2.
GB21-STALE-PRESSURE-PROVENANCE-059 + MIXED-SOURCE-060: stale secretary-derived pressure fields are ignored while trusted independent telemetry remains usable.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted fresh authority=G1/recovery projects G1 despite permissive fallback kwargs.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift history, adequate support, uncertainty and stateful release are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and lineage semantics survive restart/rollback/polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt gets zero authoritative credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is tied to one immutable accepted receipt.
GB21-V2-V21-CLASSIFIER-CONSISTENCY-078: public authoritative interfaces agree on verified-vs-operational semantics.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen metric provenance, crossover/order control, complete assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

requirements: Preserve Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 verified foundation; no candidate failure may roll them back.
Create one canonical typed EventKind boundary shared by v2 and v2.1; canonicalization must be consistent across credit, verified-event and operational-event classification.

Create strict canonical EventIdentity plus durable rollback-resistant evidence-lineage acceptance registry; exact replay=NO_OP, same evidence/new ID=lineage duplicate, same ID/different binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.
Operational progress remains non-Experience but requires durable evidence-bound acceptance; raw caller event_kind cannot create authoritative progress.
Remove direct credit bypass: v2.1 decisions consume immutable accepted receipts only.
Secretary freshness and authority must be evidence-bound; authority conflict must project the exact fresh authority decision, not merely suppress secretary_level.
Pressure components require provenance/freshness and routing must use unrounded canonical pressure.
recent_shift_rate_ratio must be derived from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted sample/window/uncertainty and bounded enter/exit hysteresis.
Anti-thrash must pass paired non-regression for cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour and recovery_latency; lower gear_shift_rate alone is insufficient.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and adversarially shown non-self-reinforcing.
5/4/3/1 credit weights remain heuristic analytics only and never capability truth or Trust/Identity/Personality/promotion threshold.

Speedup requires sealed matched paired/crossover baseline on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance, exposure/censoring/order, complete assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression; commit count/wake count/awake time forbidden.
Fresh exact-current executable v1+v2+v2.1 regression evidence, dedicated Spirit adversarial review, refreshed Navigator synthesis and normal A->B->C are still required before formal adoption.
